svg.title: The Token Meter and ROI
svg.desc: Cost per request is input tokens plus output tokens times the model's price; multiplied by monthly volume it gives operating cost, which is set against time saved, quality and scale to give ROI.
svg.text: Tokens in and out set the cost per request; volume sets the bill; value sets the return.
ROI: value created set against AI cost
Cheapest per token isn't cheapest overall if wrong answers are costly
